response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned individual-contributor engineer (~15 years) with strong breadth across backend, low-latency services, and full-stack work, but the resume shows no executive or people-leadership experience whatsoever — no evidence of managing, hiring, or scaling engineering teams, let alone building a senior leadership layer or reporting to a board. The agentic-AI requirement is met only tangentially (MCP code generators and agent tooling at re:cinq), with no production multi-agent systems, evaluation infrastructure, or LLM ops experience. Fintech exposure is limited to a ~15-month stint at RIDE Capital as a developer, without credit systems, risk modeling, or regulated AI operation. The gap between this profile and a CTO role at a venture-backed fintech scale-up is substantial across all three core pillars.
strengths: Deep distributed-systems background: microservices handling millions of req/sec at Sociomantic
Early hands-on exposure to agentic/MCP tooling and developer frameworks at re:cinq
Strong engineering-craft culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source founder, workshops and community teaching
concerns: No engineering management or executive leadership experience; never scaled a team
No production multi-agent AI systems, LLM evaluation, or ML infrastructure ownership
Minimal fintech/regulated-domain depth; no credit risk, compliance, or vendor governance work

key_factors.factor: Lack of production multi-agent AI systems experience
